name: Zoltán Kovács
bio:
Zoltán's journey into the world of motorsport began with a childhood fascination for model cars, meticulously painted and detailed in his small workshop. This passion evolved into an apprenticeship at a local autobody shop, where he honed his skills in paint application and color matching. Eager to combine his artistic talent with his love for racing, Zoltán pursued opportunities in motorsport, quickly establishing himself as a competent and experienced paint shop specialist.

Known for his unwavering commitment to quality and his meticulous eye for detail, Zoltán approaches each project with a blend of technical precision and creative flair. He believes that a car's paint job is not merely cosmetic but an integral part of its identity and performance, reflecting the team's dedication to excellence. His ability to innovate and consistently deliver flawless results sets him apart in the competitive world of motorsport.

Zoltán is a reliable and loyal team member, always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that every car leaving the paint shop meets the highest standards. He is eager to contribute his expertise to a team that values innovation, precision, and a shared passion for racing.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Zoltán is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always wears a lucky red wristband while working.
Has a habit of whistling classical music tunes while mixing paints.
Insists on using only natural light when inspecting the final paint finish.
